CustomField.description: The id an external AI service gives this conversation, such as the Anthropic Agent API session id (sesn_...), so the conversation can be matched to it without relying on the Salesforce record Id.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set by AI Assist when the AI service returns an id for the conversation. Do not change it: changing it breaks the link to the external conversation.
CustomField.label: External Reference
